d: You have millions of agent trajectories. Which ones should you train on? In this Stanford CS329Z: Engineering AI Agents lecture, John Yang, co-creator of SWE-bench and SWE-smith, explains how to find maximally informative data: filtering and selection strategies for validity and learnability, tiny-but-targeted benchmarks, annotation practices (including how SWE-bench Verified was built), quality assessment and automated checks for coding tasks, curricula for reinforcement learning, building datasets from agent traces (including failed trajectories), and when less but better data beats more…
